final: SELECT actor_films.actor_id, actor_films.film_count, actor_films.film_count * 1.0 / film_total.distinct_films AS share_of_films, actor_films.film_count * 1.0 / film_total.distinct_films - actor_avg.avg_share AS difference_from_average FROM (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id) AS actor_films CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) AS distinct_films FROM film_actor) AS film_total CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(film_count * 1.0 / distinct_films) AS avg_share FROM (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id) AS counts CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) AS distinct_films FROM film_actor) AS films) AS actor_avg ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC LIMIT 10
